verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix feature automatically scans issues, finds root causes and automates triage, and 'Seer Agent' answers questions about telemetry — this covers AI-generated incident context (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-17, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-31). However, evidence doesn't explicitly show AI-generated summaries pushed into alert notifications (e.g., Slack) for responders, only that alerts fire on rule matches without AI content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-written incident summaries embedded in alert/notification payloads, and independent/hands-on validation of Seer's summary quality for responders.
